title: Iowa State University dedicates LeBaron Complex project, advancing future of health and human sciences
summary_en: Iowa State dedicated the LeBaron Complex on Sept. 17. The approximately $54 million project completed primarily through private giving provides a modern, integrated environment for teaching, research, collaboration and experiential learning.
